coordinate_system: Godot: +Y up, -Z = north on the plan (Blender +Y). Characters/house fronts face local +Z.

lighting.note: Azimuth measured from Blender +Y (= Godot -Z, north on the level plan) towards +X (east). Lamp/window factors multiply the per-light energy and per-material emission from the glTF assets. Fire, forge and coal lights are always on.
